result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_cycle_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add a cycle graph (closed loop) to the current graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L1832-L1894){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_cycle_graph(n, type=None, label=True, rel=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Creates n nodes in a circular pattern where the last connects back to first. Each node has exactly degree `2`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [n]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of nodes in the cycle (minimum `3`). [type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional node type/category for all nodes. [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, label nodes with their IDs. [rel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional relationship label for all edges. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Create a cycle: ::: {#daa0b08c .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_cycle_graph(n=4) # Returns node count graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 4 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#b37bf11b .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns edge count graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 4 ``` ::: :::
